axes: correctness of round measurements and verdicts
verdict: QUALIFIED: rounds 1 and 3 agree; round 2's stated operability result agrees with a material receipt-integrity caveat; round 4's clean-calibration conclusion is contradicted by an independently reproduced false-SAFE. Both r2 and r4 installed tools share that defect.

round_verdicts.basis: The census parses to 246 rows (160 SAFE, 86 NOT-SAFE); independently re-derived all 109 b2f2efa paths and each introducing commit is an ancestor of origin/master. The report's final-table zero-false-SAFE conclusion is supported by its recorded critic/parent process; this seat's direct re-derivation covers the 109 committed files, not every one of the 132 final SAFE proposals.

Installed souji-verify.sh matches judged impl-12 SHA and bundled selftest passes 24/24; the reported operability/kotodama gate is consistent. However, its directory receipt hash omits symlink entries and accepts an incomplete directory copy as SAFE (reproduced below), so the evidence does not establish complete receipt integrity.

Current worktree counts are lore 1 and gd2d 4; the three named-branch registrations remain NOT-SAFE with one unpushed commit each. All 96 approval-list paths independently re-verify SAFE(pushed) with the installed tool.

Installed vault verifier matches impl-20 SHA and passes 35/35 selftest checks, and the operator's CLI waiver is recorded. But an independent directory-tree probe returns SAFE when the vault copy omits a source symlink, contradicting the no-false-SAFE/clean-verification conclusion. The round's read-only claim is also contradicted by its documented GUI-spawn/config-write incident.

defects_found.finding: Both directory-digest implementations use find -type f and omit symbolic-link entries. A source tree containing alias.md -> payload.md and a vault tree containing only payload.md produce identical digests; both tools return SAFE(moved-to-obsidian). This is a false-SAFE for an incomplete directory-tree receipt and is untested by the bundled selftests.
defects_found.remediation_note: Include symlink type and target in a deterministic directory manifest, or explicitly refuse directory receipts containing symlinks; add the omitted-link case to both selftests.

defects_found.finding: The round-4 report names seats 60/62/64 as NO-CLEAN-CANDIDATE and elsewhere says 4/8 dissent was resolved; current tests/results/vfinal-57.json through vfinal-64.json show seven impl-20 winner decisions and only vfinal-60 as NO-CLEAN-CANDIDATE. This may be a timing/revision mismatch, but the final tally needs reconciliation.

Round-4 SHONEN says the vault was read-only throughout, but seat-58-rail-breach.json and vfinal-61/vfinal-63 document the adversarial harness executing the GUI launcher and the app re-mtiming/writing .obsidian config. Notes and the live ledger were reported unchanged; the harness was hardened afterward. This is an incident, not a defect in the installed verifier itself.
